title: Counter Minimum Pay on Manufacturer Copay Card Claims by Plan — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
The counter minimum pay of a Manufacturer Copay Card of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs — the amount taken off the benefit base as held to the counter limit — follows the linked plan: **nothing** on a Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan, **10.00 dollars** on a Commercial Copay Plan, and the program's patient minimum pay on any other plan.

| Linked plan (Prescription Insurance on File) | Counter minimum pay |
|---|---|
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | $0.00 |
| Commercial Copay Plan | $10.00 |
| Any other plan | the program's patient minimum pay |

The plan is the class of the coverage record the card is linked to.
